name: craft-layer
description: Create unique, animated, informative web apps (CRM, SaaS, landing pages) across React, Tailwind, Vue, Next, Nuxt, and Laravel. /craft-layer:craft runs the studio pipeline end to end — creative direction, design research, asset sourcing with a licence gate, theming and component build via ui-ux, and a tiered motion system (Framer, anime.js, Three.js/R3F, Lottie/Rive, sprites) with reduced-motion and reduced-bundle fallbacks. /craft-layer:sections guides per-section decisions, /craft-layer:audit reviews a shipped tree, ultra-craft adds web research and a red-team. Ships the Three.js/R3F skill; its review arrives through /code-review:review. Requires ui-ux, which carries the WCAG audit.

cc_boost.title: Boost hooks (CC_BOOST)
cc_boost.description: Boost hooks that raise model and effort when a prompt carries an ultra- token: on or off. The environment variable CC_BOOST overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.

craft_boost.title: ultra-craft boost (CRAFT_BOOST)
craft_boost.description: The ultra-craft prompt boost that raises model and effort: on or off. The environment variable CRAFT_BOOST overrides this.
